title: feat(studio): standard dialogs for package/create management (+ fix clipped switcher dropdown)
body:
Addresses the Studio package-UX review: the clipped top-bar dropdown, plus consolidating Studio's ad-hoc create/manage mini-forms onto the standard `Dialog`/`Sheet` forms.

## 1. Fix: package switcher dropdown was clipped

The Studio top bar (`<header>`) uses `overflow-x-auto` so pillars/Publish never clip off a narrow viewport. CSS forces the *other* axis to `auto` too, so the switcher's `absolute` dropdown was clipped by the header instead of overlaying the canvas. Converted it to a Radix **`Popover`** (portals to `<body>`, escaping the overflow). The app-create dropdown had the identical bug — it's gone too (now a dialog, below).

## 2. Standard create dialogs (`如何弹出标准表单`)

Studio had **five** bespoke two-input mini-forms (package / app / object / flow / permission) — two clipped dropdowns, three cramped rail blocks, none matching the standard forms.

- New **`CreateItemDialog`**: one standard `Dialog` — display-name auto-slugs the identifier, optional `extra` slot (e.g. app's "scaffold nav" checkbox), inline error, busy-aware submit. **App / object / flow / permission** creates now open it; each keeps its own skeleton + draft-save logic, so behaviour (draft-only, navigate-to-designer, etc.) is preserved.
- **Package** create now opens the existing standard **`CreatePackageDialog`**.

## 3. View info + advanced ops (`查看软件包信息` / `停用 / 复制 / 删除`)

- Package switcher gains a **"Package info & settings"** entry that opens the standard **`PackageDetailSheet`** — manifest info + disable / duplicate / delete / publish / revert / export. These already existed on the admin page; now they're reachable from Studio.
- Exported `PackageDetailSheet` + `InstalledPackage`; made its `appBase` **optional** (Studio has no console-app base, so the metadata-browse / per-draft links are hidden there — every lifecycle action still works without it).

## Known gap: editing a package

Adding a package uses a standard form; **editing** a manifest (name/description/version) has **no backend endpoint** (only `POST /packages` + lifecycle sub-routes exist in the framework REST surface). So package *edit* is not wired here — it needs a `PATCH /packages/:id` in the framework repo first.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` on `@object-ui/app-shell`: **0 errors**
- `eslint` on changed files: **0 errors** (only pre-existing style warnings)
- `vitest` app-shell studio-design + metadata-admin: **581 tests pass**
